name: IIT/IIM Coming of Age
description: The quintessential Indian campus novel focusing on ambition, friendship, and intense academic pressure.

chapters.title: The Entrance Exam
chapters.description: The grueling preparation, coaching classes in Kota, and the results day.

chapters.title: First Day on Campus
chapters.description: Ragging (or intro sessions), meeting the idiosyncratic roommates.

chapters.title: The Grading Curve
chapters.description: The harsh reality of academic competition and the first major failure.

chapters.title: The Campus Romance
chapters.description: A distraction from studies; meeting someone from a different background.

chapters.title: The Mid-Sem Crisis
chapters.description: Burnout, parental pressure, and a friend's breakdown.

chapters.title: The Cultural Fest
chapters.description: Organizing the college fest; learning practical management and politics.

chapters.title: The Rebellion
chapters.description: Standing up to a tyrannical professor or the system.

chapters.title: The Internship Grind
chapters.description: Summer placements and the harsh reality of corporate life.

chapters.title: The Breakup/Betrayal
chapters.description: Friends turning into competitors; romantic fallout.

chapters.title: The Final Placements
chapters.description: Day Zero tension; interviews and the obsession with packages.

chapters.title: The Convocation
chapters.description: Graduation day; realizing that the journey was more important than the destination.

chapters.title: The Real World
chapters.description: Epilogue: Five years later, who succeeded and who found happiness.
